notes.title: Earth vs Mars - Demo Update (0.02.4195630)
notes.notes:
Increased unit variety on Downtown Showdown. This will make the level more strategic, meaning it will also be a little more difficult. 

Increased difficulty on Independence Bay and Hazy Hills. Even experienced players will find these maps more challenging.

Added a tutorial popup during city capture to help explain how capturing works

Added Next Unit button to the bottom of the screen.

Renamed and reordered some options in the Settings menu for clarity and added a Key Bindings tab so that players have a keyboard reference.
